notes:
Lead: CTO (Nina Park) — builds JetBrains plugins and a shared local index library used by IntelliJ/PyCharm plugins sold to enterprise IDE teams. Wants: low-latency streaming completions (<100ms typical for single-line), robust model/version pinning per customer, local symbol index + offline/codebase-only embeddings, and tenant-aware caching. Commercial ask: flexible pricing for plugin vendors who embed inference into the IDE vs per-customer seat.

Discovery call 2025-11-04 — Nina: "source code must never leave the customer's VPC for on-prem clients; hosted ok for SMBs with opt-in". Strong emphasis on SSO/SAML and KMS integration.

Technical highlights: plugin currently uses a local LSP for indexing and falls back to remote generation for multi-line completions. They want prefix/KV cache compatibility with our runtime and ability to pin to a quantized 4-bit variant for lower memory hosts. Concerned about model drift and needs rollout/rollback at plugin level (per-version pinning).

POC goals (quantified): 1) 75ms median single-token completion for common identifiers, 2) <250ms median for 3-line contextual suggestions, 3) <10% top-1 regression vs current in-house model on recall tests. Test corpus: 10 repos (total ~120M tokens), sample indexing time target: <30 minutes on a standard dev workstation image.

Security/Legal: legal flagged retention of indexed artifacts — prefer ephemeral indexing or CRL for indexing TTL. Need Redwood private deployment with HSM/KMS and SOC2 attest.

Internal notes (AE): Marcus ran plugin demo 2026-02-16 (see ff_2026-02-18_0A4B9 transcript). SE Priya to run Dedicated perf POC week of 2026-03-15. Drive links for perf requirements + security FAQ shared.

Quotes from Nina: "We need a predictable rollback path if a model update introduces hallucinations — rollback must be fast and per-org."

Sales friction: procurement wants explicit SLA around streaming latency and a clear path for on-prem install automation (helm + operator).
